title: Split src/storage/project_memory.rs by responsibility (delivery, retirement, read, state) without changing memory behaviour
outcome: Split src/storage/project_memory.rs by responsibility (delivery, retirement, read, state) without changing memory behaviour
acceptance: src/storage/project_memory.rs is split into child modules under src/storage/project_memory/ (delivery, retirement, read, state), with writes, admission and edit/history ownership kept in the parent, helpers moved beside their sole consumers, and only module declarations plus narrow re-exports added
Memory revisions, listing cuts, advertisements and retirement behaviour keep an identical API, and the existing test inventory and results are unchanged
